changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_items (code, name, short_description, item_type, is_core, min_quantity, max_quantity, sort_order, status, trial_eligibility, default_trial_days, trial_outcome, service_nature) SELECT seed.code, seed.name, seed.short_description, seed.item_type, seed.is_core, seed.min_quantity, seed.max_quantity, seed.sort_order, 'ACTIVE', seed.trial_eligibility, seed.default_trial_days, seed.trial_outcome, 'SOFTWARE_LICENSING' FROM ( SELECT 'CORE' AS code, 'Nucleo: clientes y mascotas' AS name, 'Gestion de clientes y sus mascotas (laboratorio)' AS short_description, 'MODULE' AS item_type, TRUE AS is_core, 1 AS min_quantity, 1 AS max_quantity, 10 AS sort_order, 'ELIGIBLE' AS trial_eligibility, 30 AS default_trial_days, 'LIMITED' AS trial_outcome UNION ALL SELECT 'SCHEDULING', 'Agenda de citas', 'Agenda y citas (laboratorio)', 'MODULE', FALSE, 1, 1, 20, 'ELIGIBLE', 30, 'LIMITED' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'Historia clinica y consultas', 'Historia clinica (laboratorio)', 'MODULE', FALSE, 1, 1, 30, 'ELIGIBLE', 30, 'LIMITED' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'Caja y punto de venta', 'Caja (laboratorio)', 'MODULE', FALSE, 1, 1, 50, 'ELIGIBLE', 14, 'READ_ONLY' UNION ALL SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING', 'Facturacion electronica DIAN', 'Facturacion electronica (laboratorio)', 'MODULE', FALSE, 1, 1, 80, 'NEVER_FREE', NULL, NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'Pack Clinica', 'Nucleo + agenda + historia clinica + caja (laboratorio)', 'BUNDLE', FALSE, 1, 1, 320, 'NEVER_FREE', NULL, NULL ) seed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_items x WHERE x.code = seed.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_item_sub_modules (catalog_item_id, sub_module_id) SELECT ci.id, sm.id FROM ( SELECT 'CORE' AS item_code, 'AGENDA' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'SCHEDULING', 'AGENDA' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'CASH' UNION ALL SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING', 'BILLING' ) seed JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.code = seed.item_code JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_sub_modules x WHERE x.catalog_item_id = ci.id AND x.sub_module_id = sm.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM catalog_item_sub_modules WHERE catalog_item_id IN ( SELECT id FROM catalog_items WHERE code IN ('CORE','SCHEDULING','CLINICAL_HISTORY','CASH_REGISTER', 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_item_dependencies (catalog_item_id, related_item_id, relation_type, note) SELECT a.id, b.id, seed.relation_type, seed.note FROM ( SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING' AS item_code, 'CASH_REGISTER' AS related_code, 'REQUIRES' AS relation_type, 'Facturar electronicamente necesita el modulo de Caja' AS note UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'SCHEDULING', 'RECOMMENDS', 'La historia clinica se llena sola desde las citas' ) seed JOIN catalog_items a ON a.code = seed.item_code JOIN catalog_items b ON b.code = seed.related_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_dependencies x WHERE x.catalog_item_id = a.id AND x.related_item_id = b.id AND x.relation_type = seed.relation_type);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM catalog_item_dependencies WHERE catalog_item_id IN ( SELECT id FROM catalog_items WHERE code IN ('ELECTRONIC_INVOICING','CLINICAL_HISTORY'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO bundle_components (bundle_item_id, component_item_id, quantity) SELECT bundle.id, comp.id, 1 FROM catalog_items bundle JOIN catalog_items comp ON comp.code IN ('CORE','SCHEDULING','CLINICAL_HISTORY','CASH_REGISTER') WHERE bundle.code = 'PACK_CLINIC' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bundle_components x WHERE x.bundle_item_id = bundle.id AND x.component_item_id = comp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM bundle_components WHERE bundle_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM catalog_items WHERE code = 'PACK_CLINIC');
